snippet.title: Bit.Trip Rerunner - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010032

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER

Video Description (Consumer Facing):
Get ready to jump, bounce, and groove your way through the retro-futuristic world of BIT.TRIP RERUNNER, now coming to PlayStation 5! CommanderVideo is back in this revitalized rhythm-runner, featuring all-new levels, remixed beats, and an intuitive level editor. Whether you're a rhythm veteran or a newcomer to the series, get ready for an electrifying challenge that will test your reflexes and put a smile on your face.

#ps5 #ps5games
